categories.name: build
categories.evidence: All changed files are in .github/ creating a new GitHub Actions workflow and CI helper scripts (.github/workflows/silent-merge-check.yml, .github/silent-merge-test.py, .github/silent-merge-report.py).
categories.rationale: Adds a periodic CI workflow that automatically tests candidate PRs merged against master to catch logical conflicts. While helpful for maintainer workflow and avoiding broken master merges, it is a non-critical CI enhancement.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' by maintainers; implements automation to run the test suite against simulated merges of open PRs.
categories.rationale: Automates test suite execution across open pull requests to detect silent merge conflicts before they reach master. The value is clear for preventing regressions, though reasonably deferrable as an auxiliary CI test runner.
